description: Custom event registry format. Each event's properties map is its complete allowlist. Property definitions use JSON Schema type/constraint keywords plus required (boolean) and description. To validate an event, require exactly the envelope fields below, verify event_type exists, then validate properties against that event's definitions. Reject unknown keys at both levels.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier; null when no session exists.

userId.description: Opaque internal user identifier; null when the user is not known.

event_type.description: Must match one event_type in the events registry, using entity_action taxonomy.

requestId.description: Opaque correlation identifier shared across frontend, backend, and logs.

properties.description: Event-specific payload; validate against the properties allowlist for event_type.

events.description: A supplier delivery of training or onboarding material is confirmed and recorded as an inbound order.

office.description: Office that owns the inventory; determines the local currency.

product_id.description: Opaque identifier of the received product.

quantity.description: Number of units received in this order line.

currency.description: Office currency; EUR for Valencia and USD for Miami. No telemetry-layer conversion.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit in the office currency.

supplier_ref.description: Opaque business identifier for the supplier; never a contact person's name or details.

total_cost.description: Optional order-line total in the office currency when available.

events.description: A delivery of a kit or certificate is confirmed and recorded as an outbound order.

product_id.description: Opaque identifier of the delivered product.

quantity.description: Number of units delivered in this order line.

currency.description: Office currency; included for consistent inventory aggregation.

recipient_type.description: Recipient category only; no recipient name or personal identifier.

events.description: A product's available stock falls below its configured minimum.

product_id.description: Opaque identifier of the product below threshold.

quantity.description: Available stock observed when the threshold is crossed.

currency.description: Office currency for consistent inventory aggregation; no conversion.

threshold_quantity.description: Configured minimum stock that was crossed.

events.description: The system rejects an attempt to change stock outside a traceable inbound or outbound order.

product_id.description: Opaque identifier of the affected product.

quantity.description: Signed quantity change the rejected attempt requested; no stock change is applied.

currency.description: Office currency for consistent inventory aggregation.

rejection_code.description: Controlled reason for rejecting the direct stock change.

events.description: An inbound order's unit cost exceeds the configured variance threshold against the same product and supplier's history.

quantity.description: Number of units in the inbound order line.

currency.description: Office currency for all cost values; no conversion.

unit_cost.description: Current unit cost in the office currency.

baseline_unit_cost.description: Historical comparison unit cost in the same currency.

variance_percent.description: Percentage variance from the historical unit cost.

threshold_percent.description: Configured percentage threshold that triggered this event.

supplier_ref.description: Opaque business identifier for the supplier; no contact-person details.

events.description: An operator opens a product detail in the inventory; repeated views may be represented as a time-window aggregate.

office.description: Office whose inventory is being viewed.

product_id.description: Opaque identifier of the viewed product.

quantity.description: Available stock displayed at view time.

currency.description: Office currency for consistent inventory aggregation.

occurrence_count.description: Number of product views represented by this event in the aggregation window.

events.description: An inbound or outbound order cannot proceed because a validation fails.

office.description: Office where the order is being entered.

validation_code.description: Controlled validation failure; never include submitted text.

product_id.description: Opaque product identifier when selected; omitted or null before selection.

quantity.description: Quantity submitted, if available and safe to represent.

currency.description: Currency derived from office (EUR for Valencia, USD for Miami), even when validation fails before product selection.

events.description: An explicitly cancelled or timed-out inbound or outbound order flow is not confirmed.

office.description: Office where the order flow started.

abandonment_trigger.description: Explicit cancellation or defined flow timeout; a session expiry alone is not sufficient.

product_id.description: Opaque product identifier if one was selected.

currency.description: Currency derived from office (EUR for Valencia, USD for Miami), even when the flow ends before cost entry.

events.description: An operator acknowledges a low-stock threshold alert.

product_id.description: Opaque identifier of the product below threshold.

quantity.description: Available stock when the alert is acknowledged.

currency.description: Office currency for consistent inventory aggregation.

trigger_event_id.description: eventId of the corresponding stock_threshold_triggered event.

events.description: An operator searches or filters inventory without recording free-text query content.

currency.description: Currency derived from office (EUR for Valencia, USD for Miami).

filters_used.description: Controlled names of filters applied; no query text.

events.description: An authentication attempt fails, including invalid credentials.

failure_code.description: Controlled failure category; no submitted credentials, email, or username.

occurrence_count.description: Number of matching failures represented in the aggregation window.

events.description: An authenticated session expires and requires the operator to authenticate again.
A user successfully authenticates to the backoffice.
The duration and result of an API request are measured.

route_group.description: Controlled route group; never a raw URL or query string.

status_code.description: HTTP response status, or null if no response was received.

sample_rate.description: Probability that this request was selected; 0.1 for routine sampled requests and 1 for slow requests or failures.

events.description: The load duration of a backoffice view is measured.
An API request fails before completing the requested operation; repeated failures may be represented as a burst summary.

route_group.description: Controlled route group; never a raw URL or query string.

status_code.description: HTTP response status, or null if no response was received.

error_code.description: Controlled error category; no raw response body or exception text.

occurrence_count.description: Number of matching failures represented by this event.

window_seconds.description: Burst aggregation window length in seconds.

events.description: The frontend encounters an uncaught exception during backoffice use; repeated identical errors may be represented as a burst summary.

error_fingerprint.description: Stable non-reversible fingerprint derived from a sanitized error signature; not the raw message or stack.

occurrence_count.description: Number of matching exceptions represented by this event.

window_seconds.description: Burst aggregation window length in seconds.

events.description: An operator navigates to a backoffice section.

office.description: Operator's office, kept separate from interface language.

interface_language.description: Interface language, an independent dimension from office.

events.description: A defined backoffice flow is explicitly cancelled or times out before completion.

abandonment_trigger.description: Explicit cancellation or defined flow timeout; session expiry alone is insufficient.

elapsed_seconds.description: Elapsed time from flow start until cancellation or timeout.
